description:
[Trading Data API] Alias of /v1/verdict. Multi-asset momentum verdict (bias, confidence, thesis, entry/invalidation/targets, signal readings) from the oracle.py pipeline, run on a separate Python service. Scoped to 10 assets.

**Example:** `/v1/momentum-score?symbol=BTC&timeframe=1h`

Use when you want a ready-made LONG/SHORT/NEUTRAL view with confidence, thesis and entry/invalidation/targets for a supported asset. Not for raw inputs (use price, atr, funding_oi). Same data as verdict, which is the newer name.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. One of: BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, NVDA, IBIT, COIN, QQQ, TQQQ, DIA.

name: momentum_score
